full.description: This is a high-power photomicrograph of brain tissue stained with hematoxylin and eosin. It displays neuronal changes characterized by shrunken, deeply eosinophilic neuronal cell bodies and pyknotic nuclei. These cytopathological findings are indicative of neuronal ischemic injury, often referred to as 'red dead neurons'. The morphological features seen in the central cell bodies and surrounding neuropil are consistent with acute neuronal necrosis.

random.description: This image is a high-power photomicrograph showing a histological section of brain tissue with reactive changes. The field demonstrates a prominent reactive astrocyte set against a pink, edematous background neuropil. Surrounding cells display enlarged, hyperchromatic nuclei and perineuronal or perivascular changes characteristic of reactive astrocytosis. These findings commonly accompany central nervous system injury, inflammation, or cystic lesions.
